title: NINA: Guide users step by step inside your product. | Product Hunt
excerpt: NINA lives inside your product and helps users exactly where they get stuck. They ask “How do I…?” by voice or text, and NINA guides them step by step on the live interface before they open a ticket, search documentation, or message support. It is not a scripted tour, chatbot, or FAQ. NINA is built for B2B SaaS teams still relying on onboarding calls, product videos, Slack channels, and repeated support answers.
